adminLocations.title: Locations
adminLocations.description: Manage infrastructure locations and their regions.
adminLocations.name: Location name
adminLocations.empty: No locations have been created yet.
adminLocations.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete location “{{name}}”?
adminLocations.invalidName: Name must contain between 1 and 100 characters.

adminLocations.unexpectedError: Unable to complete the location operation.
adminLocations.info_name: A readable location name, e.g. London DC1. Helps identify a data center or facility.
adminLocations.info_code: A short location code, unique within its region. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. lon-dc1.
adminLocations.info_region: The parent region containing this location. Regions organize infrastructure locations and nodes.
adminLocations.info_continent: The continent where the location is situated, e.g. Europe.
adminLocations.info_country: The country where the location is physically situated, e.g. United Kingdom.
adminLocations.info_state: Optional state, province or administrative area, e.g. England.
adminLocations.info_city: Optional city where the location is situated, e.g. London.
